purpose: Source-pinned public advisory triage. Records do not prove exploitability or target compatibility.

source.title: About the security content of iOS 26.7 and iPadOS 26.7

candidates.published_impact: A malicious app may be able to gain root privileges
candidates.fix_summary: Permissions issue addressed with additional restrictions
candidates.reason: Published impact is relevant to privilege boundaries, but exact build and complete chain are not established.

candidates.published_impact: An app may be able to modify protected system files
candidates.fix_summary: Path traversal addressed with improved input validation
candidates.reason: Relevant protected-file boundary; no verified target primitive or complete chain.

candidates.published_impact: A sandboxed process may be able to circumvent sandbox restrictions
candidates.fix_summary: Out-of-bounds write addressed with improved bounds checking
candidates.reason: Relevant sandbox boundary; advisory summary does not provide exploit details.

candidates.published_impact: A sandboxed app may be able to execute arbitrary code with kernel privileges
candidates.fix_summary: Race condition addressed with improved state management
candidates.reason: High-impact published description, but no exact-build confirmation or Freedom27 reproduction.

candidates.published_impact: A local attacker may be able to cause unexpected system termination or corrupt kernel memory
candidates.reason: Kernel memory impact alone does not establish useful read/write or privilege escalation.

candidates.published_impact: Connecting to a malicious NFS server may disclose kernel memory
candidates.reason: Environment-dependent disclosure; no established route for the target.

candidates.published_impact: An app may be able to cause unexpected system termination or corrupt kernel memory
candidates.fix_summary: Use-after-free addressed with improved memory management
candidates.reason: Public impact is not proof of a stable primitive or exact target applicability.

candidates.published_impact: Connecting to a malicious NFS server may lead to kernel memory corruption
candidates.fix_summary: Use-after-free addressed with improved memory management
